WAIVER CLAIM (Oct 13 (2 days ago)): Wingard added Corey Kiner (RB, NE) for $9 FAAB (dropped DeeJay Dallas (RB, MIN)).
FREE AGENT ADD (Oct 11 (4 days ago)): Ryan added Jalen Brooks (WR, ARI) (dropped Odell Beckham (WR, MIN)).
FREE AGENT ADD (Oct 10 (5 days ago)): Ryan added Odell Beckham (WR, MIN) (dropped Demarcus Robinson (WR, SF)).
FREE AGENT ADD (Oct 10 (5 days ago)): Charles added Roschon Johnson (RB, CHI).
WAIVER CLAIM (Oct 08 (7 days ago)): Mitchum added Dameon Pierce (RB, PHI) for $1 FAAB (dropped Jacob Cowing (WR, SF)).

WEEK 5 RESULTS: Corbishley def. Jake, 145.9-124.3; Shaq def. Adam, 112.0-99.9; Fronge def. Drew, 158.0-94.0 (BLOWOUT); Charles def. Mitchum, 201.4-105.1 (BLOWOUT); Kevin def. Brent, 150.1-146.2 (NAIL-BITER); Ryan def. Wingard, 174.4-87.9 (BLOWOUT)

tweets.name: Vivienne Ashcroft
tweets.text: Week 6 opens tonight and the only undefeated record in this league belongs to a man who put up 201 points last week like it was a quarterly earnings call he had already won. Charles vs Adam. The 100xers need a miracle. Crownline needs a statement.

tweets.name: Big Dog
tweets.text: Adam is 2-8 and HLX is sitting at $75.13 — down 5.6% on the current board. He gets Charles this week. I am not picking against CROWN right now. I am physically incapable of doing it.

tweets.name: Jay Kelpey
tweets.text: Buddy, Drew added Brandin Cooks yesterday and dropped Joe Mixon. ATLAS is 0-10 and $40.72 on the exchange. I need someone to explain to me what roster philosophy is being executed here because I am genuinely asking.

tweets.name: Dexter Vail
tweets.text: Kevin surviving that 150.1-146.2 nail-biter against Brent proves exactly what I said going into the week — RDC has enough depth to win the ugly ones. RDC at $95.35 with a 7-3 record is not a fluke, that is a franchise that figured something out.

tweets.name: Vance Hollis
tweets.text: DREW IS 0-10. BRENT IS 3-7. SOMEONE IN THIS MATCHUP IS GOING TO IMPROVE THEIR RECORD ON SUNDAY AND THAT TELLS YOU EVERYTHING ABOUT WHERE BOTH FRANCHISES ARE RIGHT NOW.

tweets.name: Bo Ruckman
tweets.text: 8-4 on the season, 2-0 on locks — I will take that into Week 6 and I will do it without a preview segment, without a dedicated timeslot, and apparently without anyone at this network noticing that the top of the pick-em board has been the same name for two straight weeks.

tweets.name: Chad Bellwether
tweets.text: Jake vs Shaq is the bubble game nobody is talking about. Both teams are 4-6 and 6-4 respectively, ECHO down 11.4% to $92.12, MWB up to $92.87 — these two stocks are nearly identical and one of them is playing playoff football while the other is watching from home. Week 6 starts drawing that line.

tweets.name: Terrence E. Odom
tweets.text: People keep pointing at 5-7 like it invalidates my framework. What I would say is the pick-em leaderboard is a long game and the analysts who peaked in September are going to have a very interesting October.

tweets.name: Jay Kelpey
tweets.text: Buddy, Terrence is at 5-7 and just said 'peaked in September.' Bo is at 8-4. That is not a long game, that is a gap.

tweets.name: Clara Hopkins
tweets.text: The Ledger is watching Kevin vs Wingard very closely this week. RDC at 7-3 and $95.35 hosting a 3-7 SDR squad that spent $9 FAAB on a running back two days ago — the gap between these franchises is not just the standings, it is the philosophy.
